offline_minimum: Python3 standard library for manifest/source checks
A compatible GHC for optional native Haskell replay
jsonschema if rerunning the companionv6 contract checker
optional_external_bindings: Existing Cloudflare actor/workflow/state adapter with fresh ownership, lease/fence, budget and acceptance state
credentials: No credentials or private archives are in the packet; optional bindings require existing user-authorized routes
steps: Verify all published file hashes and read ASSESSMENT/COVERAGE before interpreting inherited proof comments
Read the currentv6 workflow/technology map, then the compound actor model and formal state/memory/event sections
Compile each inherited Haskell file independently; preserve both success and missing-definition failures
Run the inherited driver and counterexamples; a printed PASS string is not the external acceptance criterion
For a new implementation, map every constructor/reducer to recovered fields and explicitly label repairs/placeholders
In a clean sandbox, freeze task inputs, expected accepted-state transitions, negative cases, permissions, budget and source pins before testing
Use fresh subagents only when available/authorized; test per-caste interface behavior, interruption/replay, receipt consumption and invalid authority claims
Admit/promote only independently accepted artifacts; record missing dependencies/UNKNOWN rather than inventing a reconstructed service
acceptance_target: Useful current task completion plus preserved memory/verification/control-loop behavior under measured recovery tests. Full disaster recovery remains unproved.
